post.title: VLOOKUP shows 0 when the source cell is empty
post.description:
vlookup returns 0 instead of blank
An empty amount in the source table comes back as a real zero, so the report reads like a settled balance. Test the lookup with IF and the gap stays visible. Save this for close.
